writing: A novel can support more than one careful reading. I want an interpretation to return to the text, so disagreement becomes a discussion of evidence rather than a contest of certainty.
writingZh: 小说可以支持多种细读。我希望解释回到文本，让分歧成为证据讨论，而非自信程度的竞赛。

title: 【阅读示例】诗歌 · The poet crossed out a grand sentence and kept a line about rain on a windowsill.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】诗歌 · Poetry can make an ordinary image feel newly visible.
reading: The poet crossed out a grand sentence and kept a line about rain on a windowsill. When she read the draft aloud, the smaller image carried the feeling she had struggled to name. She left space around it on the page.
readingZh: 诗人删去宏大句子，留下雨落窗台的诗行。朗读时，小意象传达了难命名的感受，她在纸上为它留白。
writing: Poetry can make an ordinary image feel newly visible. I enjoy a line that invites attention rather than explains every possible meaning before the reader has time to respond.
writingZh: 诗歌能让普通意象重新可见。我喜欢邀请关注的诗行，而非读者回应前就解释所有意义。

title: 【阅读示例】绘画与视觉艺术 · A painter placed two similar colors beside each other.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】绘画与视觉艺术 · Visual art rewards changes in distance and attention.
reading: A painter placed two similar colors beside each other. From across the room they seemed alike, but near the canvas one felt much warmer. A visitor walked back and forth, discovering that looking was an activity rather than a single glance.
readingZh: 画家把近似颜色并列，远看相同，近看一个更暖。访客来回走动，发现观看是一项活动，而非一瞥。
writing: Visual art rewards changes in distance and attention. Before deciding that I have understood an image, I like to notice what appears when I look again from another position.
writingZh: 视觉艺术回应观看距离和注意变化。判断理解图像前，我愿换个位置再看，留意新出现的细节。

title: 【阅读示例】摄影 · A photographer waited at the station for an empty platform.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】摄影 · A photograph frames a choice about what matters.
reading: A photographer waited at the station for an empty platform. A cleaner entered the frame, and the scene became more interesting than her original plan. She asked permission for the portrait and changed the caption to include the work behind the quiet place.
readingZh: 摄影师等空站台，清洁工入镜后画面更有意思。她征得肖像许可，修改说明，呈现安静背后的劳动。
writing: A photograph frames a choice about what matters. I want to think about the people inside that choice, not only the light, composition, and picture I hoped to bring home.
writingZh: 照片框定什么重要。我希望考虑选择中的人，而不只考虑光线、构图与想带回的画面。

title: 【阅读示例】音乐与舞蹈 · The dancers rehearsed with a familiar song until the musician changed its pace.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】音乐与舞蹈 · Music and dance share time rather than merely occupy it.
reading: The dancers rehearsed with a familiar song until the musician changed its pace. At first they tried to keep the old movements. Then they listened closely and adjusted together, turning the rehearsal into a conversation between sound and motion.
readingZh: 舞者用熟悉歌曲排练，乐手改节奏后，他们先坚持旧动作，再仔细聆听共同调整，让排练成为声音和动作的对话。
writing: Music and dance share time rather than merely occupy it. Watching a rehearsal reminds me that responsiveness can matter as much as memorizing a sequence perfectly.
writingZh: 音乐和舞蹈共享时间，不只是占用时间。排练让我想起，回应变化和完美记住顺序同样重要。

title: 【阅读示例】电影与戏剧 · In rehearsal, an actor paused before a simple line.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】电影与戏剧 · A performance carries meaning through timing, silence, and movement.
reading: In rehearsal, an actor paused before a simple line. The director first asked him to speak faster, then watched the whole scene again. The pause revealed hesitation the dialogue never stated, so it stayed in the final performance.
readingZh: 演员在简单台词前停顿。导演起初要求快说，再看全场后发现停顿揭示对白没说的犹疑，于是保留。
writing: A performance carries meaning through timing, silence, and movement. I would discuss what a choice makes visible before judging it only by the words printed in the script.
writingZh: 表演用时机、沉默和动作承载意义。我会先讨论选择呈现什么，再依据剧本词句评价。

title: 【阅读示例】设计与建筑 · A new entrance looked elegant in the model, but visitors carrying bags struggled with its narrow turn.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】设计与建筑 · Good design includes the journey through an object or a place.
reading: A new entrance looked elegant in the model, but visitors carrying bags struggled with its narrow turn. The architect watched the trial and widened the passage. The revision made the design less dramatic and the building easier to enter.
readingZh: 新入口模型优雅，但提包访客难过狭窄转角。建筑师观察后拓宽通道，设计没那么戏剧，却更易进入。
writing: Good design includes the journey through an object or a place. A beautiful drawing deserves to be tested against the ordinary movements it is supposed to support.
writingZh: 好设计包含穿行物件或空间的过程。漂亮图纸应与它需要支持的日常动作对照测试。

title: 【阅读示例】艺术欣赏与批评 · After visiting an exhibition, Tomas wrote that one painting was boring.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】艺术欣赏与批评 · Criticism becomes useful when judgment grows from description.
reading: After visiting an exhibition, Tomas wrote that one painting was boring. His teacher asked him to describe what he had actually noticed. The second review discussed color, repetition, and the experience of waiting, giving readers something they could examine themselves.
readingZh: 托马斯说画无聊。老师让他描述所见。第二稿讨论色彩、重复和等待感，让读者有能自行审视的内容。
writing: Criticism becomes useful when judgment grows from description. I can dislike a work while still explaining its choices carefully enough for another reader to understand my response.
writingZh: 判断来自描述时，批评更有用。我可以不喜欢作品，同时细致说明其选择，让读者理解我的回应。

title: 【阅读示例】新闻与新闻业 · A reporter heard a striking claim outside the market.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】新闻与新闻业 · News writing depends on more than an interesting statement.
reading: A reporter heard a striking claim outside the market. Before publishing it, she found the original notice and spoke with people affected by the change. Her final article included a correction to the rumor that had first drawn her attention.
readingZh: 记者在市场听到惊人说法，先查原通知并访谈受影响者。最终报道纠正最初吸引她的传言。
writing: News writing depends on more than an interesting statement. A clear account of sources and unanswered questions helps readers distinguish reporting from the repetition of a rumor.
writingZh: 新闻写作不只靠有趣说法。说明来源和未解问题，帮助读者区分报道与传言重复。

title: 【阅读示例】社交媒体 · A short post about the café spread quickly without its last sentence.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】社交媒体 · Social media makes sharing easy but context fragile.
reading: A short post about the café spread quickly without its last sentence. The missing line had explained that the closure was temporary. The owner reposted the full notice, learning that a message could travel farther while carrying less of its original meaning.
readingZh: 咖啡馆短帖快速传播，却少了说明暂时关闭的末句。店主重发完整通知，发现信息传得更远，也可能带得更少。
writing: Social media makes sharing easy but context fragile. Before passing on a surprising post, I want to find the complete message and understand what the cropped version leaves out.
writingZh: 社交媒体易分享，背景却脆弱。转发惊人帖子前，我想找完整消息，了解裁剪版本遗漏什么。

title: 【阅读示例】广告与传播 · The class designed an advertisement for a reusable bag.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】广告与传播 · Persuasion does not need an unlimited promise.
reading: The class designed an advertisement for a reusable bag. Their first poster promised that it solved every problem. After discussing the claim, they replaced it with a specific description of the bag and a picture of how it could be used.
readingZh: 班级设计环保袋广告，首稿承诺解决所有问题。讨论后，他们改成具体特点和使用图片。
writing: Persuasion does not need an unlimited promise. A clear advertisement can describe a real benefit while leaving the audience enough information to judge whether the product fits its needs.
writingZh: 说服不需要无限承诺。清晰广告能说明真实益处，让受众判断产品是否适合需求。

title: 【阅读示例】信息传播 · A meeting time changed three times, but the newest notice looked like the earlier ones.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】信息传播 · Communication includes helping someone recognize the current message.
reading: A meeting time changed three times, but the newest notice looked like the earlier ones. Several neighbors arrived late. The organizer added a visible update date and marked the current version, making the same information easier to identify and use.
readingZh: 会议时间改三次，新旧通知相似，邻居迟到。组织者增加醒目更新日期和当前版本标记，使信息更易识别使用。
writing: Communication includes helping someone recognize the current message. A date and a version label can matter as much as rewriting the sentence inside the notice.
writingZh: 传播也包括帮助识别当前消息。日期和版本标记可能与重写通知句子同样重要。

title: 【阅读示例】媒体素养 · A dramatic image appeared in the group chat with no date or source.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】媒体素养 · Media literacy means following a claim back toward its origin.
reading: A dramatic image appeared in the group chat with no date or source. Sofia found an earlier copy connected to a different event. She shared the original context and explained her search instead of merely calling the new caption wrong.
readingZh: 群聊出现无日期来源的夸张图。索菲娅找到关联另一事件的早期版本，分享背景和查找过程，而不只说新说明错。
writing: Media literacy means following a claim back toward its origin. Explaining that path can help other readers ask better questions the next time an impressive image appears.
writingZh: 媒体素养包括追溯说法源头。说明追溯路径，可帮助读者下次看到震撼图片时提出更好问题。

title: 【阅读示例】公共舆论 · The first comments on a town proposal were strongly negative.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】公共舆论 · Public opinion is shaped by who speaks and where they can speak.
reading: The first comments on a town proposal were strongly negative. At the public meeting, quieter residents described different experiences. The student observer compared the settings and realized that the loudest visible discussion was not automatically the whole community's opinion.
readingZh: 城镇提案最早评论强烈反对，公开会议中安静居民却讲不同经历。学生发现最响亮的可见讨论不自动代表全体意见。
writing: Public opinion is shaped by who speaks and where they can speak. I would compare several channels before describing one comment thread as a community's shared position.
writingZh: 公共舆论受谁发声、哪里能发声影响。我会比较多种渠道，不把一条评论串当社区共同立场。

title: 【阅读示例】数字内容创作 · A creator planned a tutorial video and filmed the perfect final result first.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】数字内容创作 · Useful digital content considers the viewer's starting point.
reading: A creator planned a tutorial video and filmed the perfect final result first. Then a beginner asked about a mistake that appeared halfway through. She added the missing steps and made the lesson longer, but much easier to follow.
readingZh: 创作者先拍教程完美结果。初学者问中途错误，她补入缺失步骤。视频更长，却更易跟随。
writing: Useful digital content considers the viewer's starting point. Showing a common mistake and its repair can teach more than displaying a result that seems to arrive without effort.
writingZh: 有用内容考虑观众起点。展示常见错误和修复，比展示毫不费力出现的结果更能教学。

title: 【阅读示例】信息伦理 · A writer wanted to use a neighbor's private message in an essay.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】信息伦理 · Information being available does not settle whether I should publish it.
reading: A writer wanted to use a neighbor's private message in an essay. The sentence was powerful, but its sender had not agreed to publication. The writer asked permission and accepted a refusal, rebuilding the paragraph around her own experience.
readingZh: 作者想用邻居私信写文章，句子有力，却未获公开同意。询问被拒后，她接受结果，改用自身经历重写。
writing: Information being available does not settle whether I should publish it. I want the people behind a useful detail to remain visible in the decisions I make as a writer.
writingZh: 信息能获得，不等于应该发布。我希望写作决定中仍看见有用细节背后的人。

title: 【阅读示例】衣着与个人生活 · For a school costume day, Eden repaired an old jacket instead of buying another.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】衣着与个人生活 · Clothing can carry memory as well as style.
reading: For a school costume day, Eden repaired an old jacket instead of buying another. A bright patch changed its appearance and started a conversation about where it had been worn. The garment returned to daily use with a new piece of history.
readingZh: 服装日里，伊登修旧夹克而非另买。亮色补丁引出过往故事，衣服带着新历史重回日常。
writing: Clothing can carry memory as well as style. Repairing one familiar piece may give it a role that a replacement cannot reproduce, even when both serve the same practical purpose.
writingZh: 衣着承载记忆和风格。修补熟悉衣物能赋予替代品无法复制的作用，即使实用功能相同。

title: 【阅读示例】食物与烹饪 · The recipe assumed every tomato would taste the same.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】食物与烹饪 · Cooking joins instructions with attention.
reading: The recipe assumed every tomato would taste the same. When dinner seemed unexpectedly sharp, Noor asked her grandmother to taste it with her. They adjusted the next batch together and wrote a note beside the printed quantities.
readingZh: 菜谱假设番茄味道相同。晚餐意外偏酸时，努尔请祖母共尝，调整下一批，并在印刷用量旁加笔记。
writing: Cooking joins instructions with attention. A recipe is more useful to me when it leaves room to notice the ingredients in front of me and record what changed.
writingZh: 烹饪结合指令和关注。食谱留出观察手头食材、记录变化的空间时，对我更有用。

title: 【阅读示例】住房与居住 · A new apartment had a beautiful view but nowhere convenient to leave a bicycle.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】住房与居住 · A home is also a pattern of daily movement.
reading: A new apartment had a beautiful view but nowhere convenient to leave a bicycle. During a second visit, Ana walked through an ordinary morning in her imagination. The small daily details changed how she compared the two homes on her list.
readingZh: 新公寓景色好，却不好放自行车。二次看房时，安娜想象普通早晨，日常细节改变了比较方式。
writing: A home is also a pattern of daily movement. I would consider storage, access, and familiar routines alongside the view that makes the first visit exciting.
writingZh: 住房也是日常行动的模式。我会同时考虑储物、出入和习惯，而不只看首次参观吸引人的景色。

title: 【阅读示例】交通出行 · The map suggested the shortest walk to the station.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】交通出行 · A useful route is not always the shortest one.
reading: The map suggested the shortest walk to the station. With a heavy bag, Ivo found the steep steps difficult and returned by a longer flat route. He saved both options, knowing that the best path could depend on the journey's circumstances.
readingZh: 地图建议最短步行路。伊沃提重包觉得台阶难走，回程选较长平路，保存两种选项，因为最佳路线取决于情境。
writing: A useful route is not always the shortest one. Travel information becomes more helpful when it describes the conditions that allow different people to choose well.
writingZh: 有用路线不总是最短路线。出行信息说明条件，让不同人合理选择时更有帮助。

title: 【阅读示例】旅游与探索 · A traveler rushed toward the famous viewpoint and passed a closed gate.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】旅游与探索 · Exploration can begin when a plan changes.
reading: A traveler rushed toward the famous viewpoint and passed a closed gate. A local guide offered another walk through a working orchard, with the owner's permission. The unexpected route became the most memorable part of her journal.
readingZh: 旅行者赶去名景点却遇闭门。当地向导经果园主人许可带走另一条路，意外路线成为日志最难忘部分。
writing: Exploration can begin when a plan changes. I want travel writing to respect the places and people encountered, rather than treat every unfamiliar path as something a visitor is entitled to enter.
writingZh: 探索可始于计划变化。我希望游记尊重遇到的地方与人，不把陌生路都当成访客有权进入的空间。

title: 【阅读示例】购物与消费 · A discount sign made the large box seem irresistible.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】购物与消费 · A bargain should be compared with a real need, not only another price.
reading: A discount sign made the large box seem irresistible. Before buying it, Fen checked how much she would actually use. The smaller package cost more per item but fit her need, and she left without the impressive bargain.
readingZh: 折扣牌让大盒诱人，芬先想实际用量。小包装单价高却适合需求，她没有买看似划算的大盒。
writing: A bargain should be compared with a real need, not only another price. I find a shopping decision clearer when I include what will be used and what may be wasted.
writingZh: 优惠应和真实需求比较，而不只比较价格。考虑使用量和浪费后，购物决定更清楚。

title: 【阅读示例】休闲与娱乐 · The friends planned an afternoon of competitive games.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】休闲与娱乐 · Leisure should allow different kinds of enjoyment.
reading: The friends planned an afternoon of competitive games. One member asked for something quieter, so they added a puzzle table beside the main activity. By evening, people had moved between both spaces without needing to enjoy the day in the same way.
readingZh: 朋友安排竞技游戏，有人想安静，于是旁设拼图桌。大家自由往返，不必用同样方式享受下午。
writing: Leisure should allow different kinds of enjoyment. Offering a quiet option can make a shared event more welcoming without removing the energy others came to experience.
writingZh: 休闲应容纳不同乐趣。安静选项能使活动更包容，又不取消别人想体验的热闹。

title: 【阅读示例】家庭生活管理 · The household kept buying milk because nobody knew what remained in the fridge.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】家庭生活管理 · Household organization works better when responsibility is shared.
reading: The household kept buying milk because nobody knew what remained in the fridge. A small shared list changed the pattern. At the weekend meeting, the family discussed who would update it, so the new system would not become another invisible job.
readingZh: 家人不知冰箱余量，总重复买奶。共享小清单改变情况。他们约定更新责任，避免新系统成为另一项隐形家务。
writing: Household organization works better when responsibility is shared. A clever list is only a beginning if one person must quietly maintain it for everyone else.
writingZh: 家庭管理在共同承担责任时更好。若仍全靠一人默默维护，聪明清单也只是起点。

title: 【阅读示例】公共与生活服务 · A visitor at the public service desk could not understand the ticket machine.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】公共与生活服务 · Everyday services deserve to be understandable on the first visit.
reading: A visitor at the public service desk could not understand the ticket machine. An assistant explained the options and watched where he hesitated. Her notes helped the office rewrite the labels, reducing a difficulty that many previous visitors had faced silently.
readingZh: 公共服务窗口访客不懂取号机。工作人员解释并观察犹疑点，笔记帮助重写标签，减少过去人们默默面对的困难。
writing: Everyday services deserve to be understandable on the first visit. Observing a real user's hesitation can reveal a problem that experienced staff no longer notice.
writingZh: 日常服务应让首次使用者也理解。观察真实使用者犹疑，能发现熟练员工不再注意的问题。

title: 【阅读示例】形而上学 · A child asked whether a repaired toy was still the same toy after every part had changed.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】形而上学 · Metaphysics can begin with an ordinary object.
reading: A child asked whether a repaired toy was still the same toy after every part had changed. Her uncle answered with another question about the memories attached to it. Their walk home became a discussion about objects, continuity, and what a name preserves.
readingZh: 孩子问玩具所有部件换过后是否还是原玩具。叔叔反问相关记忆，回家路变成关于物件、连续性和名称的讨论。
writing: Metaphysics can begin with an ordinary object. A thought experiment helps me examine what I mean by sameness without assuming that the first familiar answer settles the question.
writingZh: 形而上学可始于普通物件。思想实验帮助审视“相同”的意义，不假设第一个熟悉答案就能解决问题。

title: 【阅读示例】认识论 · Two friends heard the same claim from different people.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】认识论 · Knowing asks for reasons as well as confidence.
reading: Two friends heard the same claim from different people. One trusted the speaker; the other asked for the original record. They compared their reasons and discovered that agreement about an answer did not mean agreement about how they knew it.
readingZh: 两位朋友听到同一说法，一人信任讲述者，一人找原记录。比较理由后，他们发现答案一致不等于认知方式一致。
writing: Knowing asks for reasons as well as confidence. I want to distinguish what I observed, what I inferred, and what I accepted from another person's testimony.
writingZh: 知识要求理由，不只要求自信。我希望区分观察到的、推断出的和接受他人证言的内容。

title: 【阅读示例】伦理学 · The club had one ticket left and two members who wanted it.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】伦理学 · An ethical question often contains several reasonable concerns.
reading: The club had one ticket left and two members who wanted it. A coin toss seemed fair until someone explained an earlier promise. The group paused to compare equal chances with keeping commitments, discovering that fairness involved more than one consideration.
readingZh: 社团只剩一票，两人想要。抛硬币看似公平，却有人提出先前承诺。大家比较平等机会与信守承诺，发现公平有多重考量。
writing: An ethical question often contains several reasonable concerns. I prefer to name those concerns before choosing, so a simple rule does not hide the people and commitments affected.
writingZh: 伦理问题常含多个合理关切。我喜欢选择前先说明它们，避免简单规则遮住受影响的人与承诺。

title: 【阅读示例】逻辑与批判性思维 · An argument sounded convincing because its speaker listed many examples.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】逻辑与批判性思维 · Critical thinking includes checking the bridge between evidence and a claim.
reading: An argument sounded convincing because its speaker listed many examples. Priya asked whether those examples actually supported the final claim. One belonged to a different situation, and removing it made the group state a smaller conclusion they could defend.
readingZh: 发言者列出很多例子，论证很有说服力。普莉娅问例子是否支持结论，发现一例情境不同。去掉后，大家提出更小但有依据的结论。
writing: Critical thinking includes checking the bridge between evidence and a claim. A narrower conclusion with clear support can be stronger than a dramatic statement built from unrelated examples.
writingZh: 批判思维包括检查证据通向结论的桥。范围较小但依据清晰的结论，比无关例子组成的大说法更强。

title: 【阅读示例】意识与心灵哲学 · A story described a machine that spoke exactly like its maker.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】意识与心灵哲学 · The mind invites questions that behavior alone may not settle.
reading: A story described a machine that spoke exactly like its maker. Readers agreed about its behavior but disagreed about its inner experience. The discussion ended with a list of questions, showing that an observable response and a claimed feeling were not the same thing.
readingZh: 故事里机器说话像制造者。读者对行为一致，却对内在体验分歧。讨论列出问题，区分可见回应和声称的感受。
writing: The mind invites questions that behavior alone may not settle. I want a philosophical discussion to separate what can be observed from the experience it is trying to explain.
writingZh: 心灵引出行为本身未必解决的问题。我希望哲学讨论区分可观察事物和试图解释的体验。

title: 【阅读示例】自由与政治哲学 · A fictional island let residents choose every activity except the time the harbor closed.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】自由与政治哲学 · Political philosophy can examine the conditions behind a choice.
reading: A fictional island let residents choose every activity except the time the harbor closed. A character praised the freedom until a late arrival changed her view. The class debated how personal choices and shared arrangements could limit one another.
readingZh: 虚构岛屿让人选择活动，却固定港口关闭时间。角色称赞自由，迟到后改观。班级讨论个人选择与共同安排如何相互限制。
writing: Political philosophy can examine the conditions behind a choice. Calling a person free is only a beginning if we have not discussed the rules and shared resources shaping that freedom.
writingZh: 政治哲学可审视选择背后的条件。若未讨论规则和共享资源如何塑造自由，称人自由只是起点。

title: 【阅读示例】价值与人生意义 · At the reunion, three friends described what made their year worthwhile.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】价值与人生意义 · Meaning may grow through different commitments rather than one public measure.
reading: At the reunion, three friends described what made their year worthwhile. One named a promotion, another a repaired friendship, and the third a quiet project nobody else had seen. Listening changed how each understood the word success.
readingZh: 重逢时，朋友分别说升职、修复友谊、无人看见的安静项目让一年值得。倾听改变了对成功的理解。
writing: Meaning may grow through different commitments rather than one public measure. I want to ask what an achievement expresses before deciding that its visibility tells me how valuable it is.
writingZh: 意义可能来自不同投入，而非单一公共尺度。我希望先问成就表达什么，不凭可见度决定价值。

title: 【阅读示例】思想史 · A reading group followed one idea through texts written centuries apart.
writingTitle: 【写作示例】思想史 · The history of ideas asks how a question traveled and changed.
reading: A reading group followed one idea through texts written centuries apart. The same word changed its emphasis as the surrounding questions changed. Their notes placed each passage in context, allowing comparison without pretending that all the authors were having the same conversation.
readingZh: 读书会追踪跨世纪文本中的观念。同一词语随问题背景改变重点。笔记保留语境，比较而不假装作者讨论完全同一问题。
writing: The history of ideas asks how a question traveled and changed. I enjoy comparisons that preserve context, because a familiar word can carry an unfamiliar argument in another time.
writingZh: 思想史询问问题如何传播和变化。我喜欢保留背景的比较，因为熟悉词语在另一时代可能承载陌生论证。
